questions.q: Why were Ginger and Black Beauty good for both riding and driving?
choices: They had racing blood and were about fifteen and a half hands
They were both quite old and calm and never shied at anything
They were strong cart-horses bred for heavy farm work
They had both been trained by the best grooms in London
questions.evidence: We stood about fifteen and a half hands high

questions.q: Who rode Black Beauty on the riding parties?
choices: The mistress
The master
Miss Jessie
James Howard

questions.q: Black Beauty says a "light hand" is a comfort to horses. What is a light hand?
choices: A rider who holds the reins gently
A rider who weighs very little
A rider who carries a lamp at night
A rider who uses only a short whip
questions.evidence: her hand was so light on the rein that I was guided almost without feeling it

questions.q: Why did Ginger say her mouth was not as perfect as Black Beauty's?
choices: Her breaking in and the gag bit in London
She had been fed on bad, musty hay for years
She was older than Black Beauty
Merrylegs had bitten her mouth once
questions.evidence: it was all the fault of breaking in, and the gag bit in London

questions.q: What was unusual about Sir Oliver's tail?
choices: It was only six or seven inches long
It was pure white, though he was dark
It was braided with ribbons for shows
It was longer than the rest of his body
questions.evidence: it really was only six or seven inches long

questions.q: How did Sir Oliver feel when Black Beauty asked what accident took his tail?
choices: Angry, because it was a cruel act and no accident
Happy to tell what he thought was a funny story
Embarrassed, so he turned away and said nothing
Confused, because he could not remember how
questions.evidence: it was no accident! it was a cruel, shameful, cold-blooded act!

questions.q: Why was losing his tail a lifelong problem for Sir Oliver?
choices: He could never brush the flies off his sides again
He could never run as fast as the other horses again
He could not keep himself warm in the winter
The other horses all laughed at him for it
questions.evidence: how could I ever brush the flies off my sides

questions.q: In the orchard talk, what do the horses blame for docked tails, tight bits, and blinkers?
choices: Fashion
Bad weather
Lazy grooms
The farmers

questions.q: What happened to the puppies of Sir Oliver's friend Skye?
choices: Their tails and ear flaps were cut off
They were all sold to a lady in town
They ran away into the woods and were lost
They were given away to the farmer's boys
questions.evidence: they had all had a piece of their tails cut off

questions.q: How did Merrylegs cool everyone down when they began talking against men?
choices: He reminded them their master, John and James were always good to them
He told them it was late and they should all go off to sleep
He started a race to the end of the orchard to cheer them up
He agreed that all men were cruel and none could be trusted
questions.evidence: You know that master, and John and James are always good to us

questions.q: According to Justice, what are blinkers supposed to do?
choices: Prevent horses from shying and getting frightened
Keep the bright sun and the dust out of a horse's eyes
Make carriage horses look neat and handsome
Help horses find their way in the dark
questions.evidence: to prevent horses from shying and starting

questions.q: Why did Sir Oliver think blinkers were dangerous at night?
choices: Horses see better in the dark than men and need full use of their eyes
Blinkers shine in the lamplight and frighten the other horses on the road
Blinkers soak up the night dew and become too heavy for the horse to wear
Blinkers come loose easily at night and fall down over the horse's eyes
questions.evidence: we horses can see much better in the dark than men can

questions.q: What happened to the hearse near Farmer Sparrow's house?
choices: It overturned into the pond and both horses drowned
It lost a wheel in a deep rut in the road
It ran into a big oak tree beside the lane
It was struck by lightning during a storm
questions.evidence: the hearse was overturned into the water

questions.q: What secret did Merrylegs share about John?
choices: John does not approve of blinkers
John is going to leave Birtwick
John wants to buy Ginger himself
John is secretly afraid of horses
questions.evidence: I believe John does not approve of blinkers

questions.q: How did the long talk in the orchard end?
choices: The horses ran off to eat apples the wind had blown down
The master called them all in to work in the carriage
A thunderstorm began and they ran under the trees
Sir Oliver grew tired and fell asleep in the shade
